# Omarchy theme fixtures

`<name>.toml` is `/usr/share/omarchy/themes/<name>/colors.toml` from omarchy-dev 4.0.0.r7083 (MIT), copied 2026-10-23: every stock theme, in the named-key layout (`mode`, `background`, `lighter_background`, `foreground`, `dark_foreground`, `muted`, `selection`, `accent`, …).

`terminal-style-solitude.toml` is the older layout Omarchy wrote to `~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml` before that (terminal keys: `foreground`, `background`, `selection_background`, `color0`…`color15`), copied from this machine the same day. A theme set before the update keeps that layout until the next `omarchy theme set`.
